blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Prosecution counsel Lorna Kapunan did not let the defense’s “misplaced” use of the idiom “you can’t have your cake and eat it too” go unchallenged during Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Wednesday. It was defense counsel Justin Nicol Gular who used the expression when Kapunan questioned his line of questioning during the direct examination of defense witness Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay, corporate counsel of Gencorp Industries Inc. and Metro City Chow Foods Corp.
